title: Major retailers and banks blocking or gating third-party AI agents
content:
X author: @jonattias

Amazon, Charles Schwab, JPMorgan Chase, Delta, and others are blocking unnamed third-party AI agents (including Meta's Muse) via robots.txt or terms, or requiring signed profiles and spending limits, while building their own; Walmart launched an Agent Gateway for authenticated agents.

- None supplied

novelty.reason: None of the previously seen items cover major retailers and financial institutions blocking third-party AI agents or Walmart launching an Agent Gateway.
